title: Sustainable Modular Debiasing of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model representations and downstream performance using three intrinsic metrics (BEC-Pro for gender-profession associations, DisCo for masked token probability distributions across gendered templates, and WEAT for static word embedding associations between genders and science/art concepts) and two extrinsic benchmarks (Bias-STS-B for semantic textual similarity differences, and Bias-NLI for evaluating gender-occupation inference neutrality).
